description: This is a PHP source file defining an Error Exception class within the OpenCart admin controller namespace. The class extends a base controller and provides a method to display an exception/error page with breadcrumb navigation and common layout components.

classes.name: Opencart.Admin.Controller.Error.Exception
classes.description: Defines an error exception handling class that extends the base Controller class, used for displaying error pages within the admin section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays an error exception page with breadcrumb navigation, header, footer, and layout components. Accepts message, code, file, and line parameters for error details.
